The current character `p[i]` should be matched against `s[max_j]` (if taking one character) or `s[max_j]` and `s[max_j+1]` (if taking two characters). The current implementation incorrectly checks `s[max_j]` as if it were the starting point for the current match, which is not how the range-based DP should work. This leads to incorrect pruning and an inability to correctly determine reachability.
